1337 Ottawa Avenue (Rezoning)

The District is processing a rezoning application for 1337 Ottawa Avenue to facilitate a two lot subdivision and develop a single family dwelling on each lot. The subject property is currently zoned Residential Single Family Dwelling Zone 3 (RS3). A variance to maximum permitted height from 10.5 metres to 11.2 metres has been requested.

At the May 11, 2026 Council meeting, Council set the date for readings of the bylaw.

First readingJune 8, 2026
